title: Craft Tampa

services.name: Brunch Cruises
services.desc: Join us for Tampa’s most unique brunch aboard Craft as we take you on a culinary and cocktail river journey. Our Executive Chef has freshly prepared a delectable menu, in America’s first open kitchen using gas cooking equipment on a river cruiser. As you pass beneath the many low bridges in the heart of Tampa with inches to spare, you will experience the best sites our city has to offer, including the historic Tampa Hotel with its iconic minarets dating back to 1891. You may just think you’re on a scenic river cruise in Europe! When making a reservation, guests can choose from three seating options: the air-conditioned dining room, the covered back deck, or the shared outdoor bar. Outdoor
